text.en: When your ballot is marked, fold it and hand it to the poll officials.
text.fr: Une fois votre bulletin rempli, pliez-le et remettez-le aux responsables du scrutin.

source.quote: Once marked, fold it and present it to the poll officials.

verification.evidence: Your vote is secret. You will be invited to go behind the screen to mark your ballot. Once marked, fold it and present it to the poll officials.

text.en: Your ballot carries a number, and the poll official tears that number off.
text.fr: Votre bulletin porte un numéro, et le responsable du scrutin détache ce numéro.

source.quote: The poll official will tear off the ballot number

verification.evidence: The poll official will tear off the ballot number and give your ballot back to you to deposit in the ballot box.

text.en: Once the polls have closed, every ballot is counted. The results are then made public.
text.fr: Une fois les bureaux de scrutin fermés, chaque bulletin est compté. Les résultats sont ensuite rendus publics.

source.quote: When the polls close, every ballot is counted and the results are made public.

verification.evidence: When the polls close, every ballot is counted and the results are made public.
